upg9:0.1: The Safeguard about the Factors of Awakening
upg9:2.1: While rolling on through the rounds of birth and death all suffering is destroyed
upg9:2.2: (by) the seven Factors of Awakening, which crush Māra’s army.
upg9:3.1: Having Awakened to these seven they are supremely released from the three worlds,
upg9:3.2: and have gone to (that state where there is) no birth, no ageing, no sickness, no death and which is free from fear.
upg9:4.1: Being endowed with this quality and a collection of countless other qualities
upg9:4.2: it is a medicinal mantra: we will recite those factors of Awakening.
upg9:6.1: The Factors of Awakening are agreed upon as mindfulness, and then investigation of the (nature of) things,
upg9:6.2: And after that the Factors of Awakening of energy, joyful-interest and calm,
upg9:6.3: (Then) the Factors of Awakening of concentration and equanimity: these seven
upg9:6.4: were well-proclaimed by the All-Seeing Sage, when developed and practiced
upg9:6.5: They lead to deep knowledge, Emancipation and Awakening:
upg9:7.1: By this declaration of the truth may you be safe at all times!
upg9:8.1: At one time The Lord, having seen that Moggallāna and Kassapa
upg9:8.2: Were sick and suffering, taught these seven Factors of Awakening,
upg9:8.3: And having rejoiced in them, they were freed from illness in an instant:
upg9:9.1: By this declaration of the truth may you be safe at all times!
upg9:10.1: One day the Dhamma-King was oppressed by sickness,
upg9:10.2: And after the Elder Cunda had recited them with respect,
upg9:10.3: Having rejoiced he rose from that affliction on the spot:
upg9:11.1: By this declaration of the truth may you be safe at all times!
upg9:12.1: These afflictions were abandoned by these three Great Seers,
upg9:12.2: Just as the defilements are destroyed by the path, attained in accordance with nature:
upg9:13.1: By this declaration of the truth may you be safe at all times!
